title: RandomDupes
description: A collection of random & dumb dupes for your server
body:
I got tired of there not being dupe plugins with dumb dupes, so i'm doing my own.

This is a plugin developed with the objective of making a full collection of dupes, useful or not. Feel free to suggest any random dupe!

**No folia support, yet.**

# Available Dupes
- Donkey Death Dupe
- 1.17 Anvil Dupe
- Lava Dupe
- Minecart Portal Dupe
- /dupe (soon)
# Commands
- /randomdupes
- /randomdupes reload
